statement: Organization, Role, Membership and Post are reusable primitives but the vocabulary is not a complete accountability model.
actakit_implication: Use small local Entity kinds/associations and extend only when needed; do not import a full RDF organizational ontology.

statement: The standard itself evolved around Post and change/provenance modeling, showing generic membership abstractions need domain refinement.
actakit_implication: Keep role/post/association semantics versioned/extensible rather than freezing one civic relationship schema.
